title: Patient Terms for Referrals & Prior Authorizations: Validity, Expiry and Extension
content:
A Referrals & Prior Authorizations case covers services dated from its first date of validity through its valid-through date. The day after the valid-through date the referral expires, it is closed on that day, and any units still unused lapse.

## Terms

1. **Notice before expiry.** The patient is told the type's expiry-notice number of days before the valid-through date, and again when the units remaining fall to the type's nearly-used-up figure, that more care may need an extension. The coordinator aims to request the extension the type's extension-request lead number of days ahead.
2. **Status for an extension.** An extension is requested only while the referral status is approved or exhausted, as the referral record shows it. An expired, cancelled or finally denied referral cannot be extended, and a new request is opened instead.
3. **Extension count.** An extension is granted only while the referral's count of extensions already granted is below the type's maximum number of extensions, as the referral record shows it.
4. **Retired term, no longer in force:** the term under which each extension adds the type's extension validity days to the valid-through date and, where the type's extension units are above zero, grants those units, with an exhausted referral returning to approved on that grant. This term has been superseded by the current basis.
5. **Re-evaluation.** Where the type requires a re-evaluation before an extension, a completed re-evaluation visit must precede the request.
6. **Standing referrals.** The Standing Specialist Referral cannot be extended; it is renewed by a new request.

An approved referral also moves to exhausted when its last authorized unit is used, and the payer may approve an extension that adds units to an exhausted authorization, returning it to approved.

## Terms 2 and 3 together (hypothetical cases)

| Referral status | Extensions already granted | Type's maximum | Term 2 | Term 3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| approved | 0 | 1 | met | met |
| exhausted | 1 | 2 | met | met |
| approved | 1 | 1 | met | not met |
| expired | 0 | 2 | not met — a new request is opened instead | — |
| cancelled | 0 | 1 | not met — a new request is opened instead | — |

## Expiry dates (hypothetical)

A referral valid through 2026-07-31 covers a visit dated 2026-07-31. On 2026-08-01 it expires and is closed, and a visit dated 2026-08-01 is outside it.

superseded_clauses: Each extension adds extension_validity_days to valid_through and, where extension_units is above 0, grants those units (an exhausted referral returns to approved on that grant).
